def transform(grid):
    # Crop the top-left quadrant of the 8x8 patterned figure, omitting surrounding blank rows/columns.
    nz = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in nz), max(r for r, _ in nz)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in nz), max(c for _, c in nz)
    h, w = (r1-r0+1)//2, (c1-c0+1)//2
    return [row[c0:c0+w] for row in grid[r0:r0+h]]
PY
